cases.explain: Моисей is the indirect object of сказал (said to whom), which takes the dative case.

cases.translation: But Aaron's staff swallowed up their staffs.
cases.explain: посох is the subject of проглотил, so it takes the nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.translation: The staff will turn into a serpent.
cases.explain: The construction превратиться в takes the accusative; feminine nouns in -я end in -ю in the accusative.

cases.translation: I will strike the water of the Nile.
cases.explain: The preposition по here (strike upon) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: Wait for the king of Egypt on the bank of the Nile.
cases.explain: берег (bank) governs a following noun in the genitive: the bank of the Nile.

cases.translation: The fish in the Nile will die.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Тогда я обращу руку мою на ___.
cases.translation: Then I will turn my hand against Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition на with direction takes the accusative; inanimate Египет has accusative equal to nominative.

cases.translation: When I stretch out my hand over Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over/above) always governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Моисею было 80 лет, а Аарону 83 года, когда они говорили с фараоном.
reading.question: How old were Moses and Aaron when they spoke to Pharaoh?
reading.explain: The text says Moses was 80 years old and Aaron 83 when they spoke to Pharaoh.

reading.ru: Аарон бросил свой посох перед фараоном и его приближенными, и он превратился в змею.
reading.question: What happened when Aaron threw down his staff?
reading.explain: The text says Aaron's staff turned into a serpent.

reading.ru: Каждый бросил свой посох, и те превратились в змей, но посох Аарона проглотил их посохи.
reading.question: What did Aaron's staff do to the magicians' staffs?
reading.explain: The text says Aaron's staff swallowed up their staffs.

reading.ru: Рыба в Ниле умерла, и река стала такой зловонной, что египтяне не могли пить из нее.
reading.question: What happened to the Nile after it turned to blood?
options: The fish died and the river became foul
reading.correct: The fish died and the river became foul
reading.explain: The text says the fish died and the river became so foul the Egyptians could not drink from it.

reading.ru: А египтяне стали копать колодцы вдоль Нила, чтобы добыть питьевую воду.
reading.question: What did the Egyptians do to get drinking water?
options: They dug wells along the Nile
reading.correct: They dug wells along the Nile
reading.explain: The text says the Egyptians dug wells along the Nile for drinking water.

reading.ru: С тех пор, как Господь поразил воду в Ниле, прошло семь дней.
reading.question: How many days passed after Yahweh struck the Nile?
reading.explain: The text says seven days passed after Yahweh struck the river.
